meta.title: Veritempo — Attendance, time & access control management | VGT
meta.description: Veritempo, VGT's solution for managing your employees' time, attendance, and access. Biometrics, mobile and web apps, and integration with your payroll.

hero.title: All-in-one time, attendance, and access control management
hero.subtitle: Veritempo is VGT's solution for managing your employees' time, attendance, and access, in a secure, intuitive, and centralized environment. We support you from implementation through ongoing support.

modules.title: A solution for every area of your business
modules.subtitle: Each module works independently or integrated, adapting exactly to your organization's needs.

items.title: Time
items.description: Work time tracking and control: shift management and planning, automatic timesheets, logging of events and incidents, time-off and leave management, and productivity measurement.

items.title: Access
items.description: Facility access control with a complete movement history, biometric recognition (fingerprint, face, and iris), and vehicle access logging and control.

items.title: Guest
items.description: End-to-end visitor management: biometric data registration, scheduling of visits for people and vehicles, and tracking of assets handed over.

items.title: Coworking
items.description: Occupancy control and workspace booking: web scheduling, real-time occupancy control, and facility usage monitoring.

items.title: Lunch
items.description: Corporate cafeteria management: menu planning, serving-shift administration, attendance integration, and biometric identification for access.

marking.title: Multiple ways to clock in, for any environment
marking.subtitle: From physical biometric devices to web and mobile apps, Veritempo adapts to how and where your team works.

items.title: Biometric
items.description: Fingerprint, facial recognition, and iris devices. Compatible with ZKTeco, Suprema, and VIRDI for physical environments.
features: Validation by fingerprint, face, and iris
Native integration with ZKTeco, Suprema, and VIRDI

items.title: Mobile App
items.description: App available on Google Play, App Store, and AppGallery for clocking in from anywhere with geolocation.

items.title: Web App
items.description: A solution for desk-based employees: compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, with advanced productivity control.
features: Facial clock-in from the computer's camera

integrations.title: Connected to your technology ecosystem
integrations.subtitle: Veritempo integrates natively with the market's leading payroll platforms and biometric devices.

benefits.title: Results you can measure from the first month
benefits.subtitle: Organizations implementing Veritempo report concrete, measurable improvements in their HR operations.

items.title: Higher productivity
items.description: Automate manual tasks and free your HR team for activities of greater strategic value to the company.

items.title: Less time on operations
items.description: Payroll closings that used to take days are processed in hours thanks to automation and data integration.

items.title: No more clock-in errors
items.description: Biometrics and geolocation eliminate time-tracking fraud and the errors inherent to manual clock-ins.

items.title: Provable ROI
items.description: Savings in operational time and fewer incidents deliver a measurable return on investment within the first months.

cta.subtitle: Request a free personalized demo and discover how Veritempo can transform your workforce management.
